name: fuckfacebook
description: Build and test tooling for the Fuck Facebook browser extension

scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run lint:firefox
scripts.test:unit: node scripts/build.mjs && node tests/build.cjs && node tests/timer.cjs && node tests/timer.cjs --worker && node tests/timer-android.cjs && node tests/timer-debug.cjs && node tests/timer-debug.cjs --chrome
scripts.lint:firefox: node scripts/build.mjs firefox && web-ext lint --source-dir dist/firefox --warnings-as-errors
scripts.test:all: npm test && npm run test:chrome && npm run test:firefox
